name: Date picker
summary: A modal dialog for choosing a single date, with two interchangeable display modes — a calendar grid and a single free-text field — toggled in place inside the same container. Range selection is a related but separate mode, noted only briefly here.

inputs.name: selectedDateMillis
inputs.description: Epoch UTC milliseconds at the start of the selected day, or null for no selection.

inputs.name: onSelectedDateChange
inputs.description: Called with the new selected date in epoch UTC milliseconds.

inputs.name: displayedMonthMillis
inputs.description: Epoch UTC milliseconds identifying the month currently shown in the calendar grid.

inputs.name: onDisplayedMonthChange
inputs.description: Called when paging or navigation changes the displayed month.

inputs.name: minYear
inputs.description: Lower bound of the selectable year range.

inputs.name: maxYear
inputs.description: Upper bound of the selectable year range.

inputs.name: displayMode
inputs.description: Calendar grid vs. free-text entry. Both modes share one selection state, so switching does not lose the in-progress date.

inputs.name: onDisplayModeChange
inputs.description: Called when the mode-toggle icon button switches displayMode.

inputs.name: showModeToggle
inputs.description: Shows the calendar/keyboard mode-toggle icon button in the header.

inputs.name: isDateSelectable
inputs.description: Returns whether a given date may be selected; unselectable dates render disabled in the grid and are rejected by input-mode validation.

anatomy.name: Header
anatomy.description: Supporting text ("Select date") above a large headline showing the current selection; the mode-toggle icon button sits at its bottom-trailing corner.

anatomy.name: Weekday row
anatomy.description: 7 single-letter day-of-week labels, aligned above the grid columns. Picker mode only.

anatomy.name: Calendar grid
anatomy.description: One month per page; day cells in a fixed 7-column by 6-row layout. Picker mode only.

anatomy.name: Day cell
anatomy.description: Label text; states are unselected, selected, today, disabled and, in range mode, in-range or range-endpoint.

anatomy.name: Month navigation bar
anatomy.description: Previous/next icon buttons flanking a year menu button (text + chevron that flips 180 degrees when the year grid is open). The icon buttons follow the icon-button spec; this token group supplies no icon-button-specific tokens.

anatomy.name: Year grid
anatomy.description: Replaces the calendar grid when the year menu is open: a 3-column, N-row grid of year chips.

anatomy.name: Date input field
anatomy.description: Input mode only: one outlined, numeric-only text field standing in for day, month and year, plus inline error supporting text. The field itself is styled by the outlined text-field spec; comp.date-input-modal supplies only the surrounding container and header.

anatomy.name: Actions row
anatomy.description: Cancel/OK text buttons, owned by the surrounding dialog spec, not by these token groups.

variants.description: Default visual month browsing via a calendar grid.
Fast keyboard entry, or an accessibility fallback. Both display modes live in one component instance and share its selection state; switching modes does not lose the in-progress date.
A start/end date pair, using additive range-selection-* tokens on top of every day/year token from the single-date picker. Otherwise the same grid and paging behaviour.

layout.text: Every day and weekday cell reserves a 48dp minimum touch target even though its visual box is the smaller date-container-width/height token; the visual box is centered inside the tap target.

The grid always reserves 6 rows by 7 columns, laid out with even spacing on both axes, regardless of how many weeks the current month spans — leading/trailing cells are blank spacers, not shared with adjacent months.
The month/year navigation bar has a fixed height, and the grid area gets a fixed horizontal inset; neither is tokenized.

Header padding is hard-coded, not tokenized: the title text takes 24dp/12dp/16dp start/end/top; the headline takes 24dp/12dp/12dp start/end/bottom; the mode-toggle button sits 12dp from the end and bottom edges.
The year grid is fixed at 3 columns with 16dp vertical gutters; it opens pre-scrolled a few years before the current selection so backward browsing needs less scrolling.
Months page one at a time in a horizontally snapping list, with no adjacent-month peeking; reaching a page boundary by swipe or nav-button tap smooth-scrolls exactly one month.

date-picker-modal and date-input-modal size the dialog to whichever mode is active via their own container-height/width tokens; drive the height change through the same transition used for the display-mode toggle, rather than treating them as separate dialogs.

states.text: Filled with date-selected-container-color and date-selected-label-text-color. Selecting a day animates the container colour/opacity only on the transition into the selected state, not on every recomposition, so range fills don't flicker.

states.label: today
states.text: A 1dp outline in date-today-container-outline-color when unselected; the outline is dropped once the day is also selected.
Rendered from the app-supplied isDateSelectable/selectableDates result; a disabled day cannot be tapped or focused into selection.

states.label: in-range
states.text: Range mode only: a pill background using the range-selection-active-indicator tokens, plus selection-date-in-range-label-text-color for the label.

behaviour.text: Display-mode toggle (picker to input) cross-fades and slides: entering content slides in from a -48dp offset using the default-spatial spring and fades in with default-effects; exiting content slides out and fades with fast-effects; the container itself resizes between the two modes' heights using a clipped default-spatial size transform.
Year grid open/close is a plain expand/shrink plus fade; the chevron on the year menu button rotates 180 degrees with no named spring.

Date input is a single numeric text field, not separate day/month/year fields: digits are typed contiguously and delimiters (e.g. a slash) are inserted automatically by an output transformation as you type, following the locale's date pattern.

Input validation runs once the digit count matches the pattern length and reports one of, as inline error text: a malformed or incomplete date, a year outside the allowed range, a date excluded by isDateSelectable, or — in range mode — a start/end ordering conflict.

keyboard: Arrow keys move focus by day, honouring RTL (left/right swap); focus can cross month boundaries, scrolling the grid to follow it.
Tab and Shift+Tab move between the currently-displayed year's chip and the surrounding UI when the year grid is open.
Enter or Space selects the focused day, year chip, or activates the focused button.
Escape or a platform back action dismisses the enclosing dialog.
semantics: Day and weekday cells use the button role with merged semantics carrying the full spoken date, appending "today" and/or "in range" as applicable; the 48dp tap target holds even if the caller shrinks the visual cell.
Navigation and mode-toggle icon buttons carry tooltips and explicit content descriptions, e.g. "Switch to next month", "Switch to year selection".
The input field sets an error state and description whenever validation fails, so screen readers announce the problem immediately.

notes.text: Motion specs are placeholders in Compose: DatePicker.kt reads named springs from the global MotionScheme rather than its own per-component tokens, pending a future update. Treat the springs cited here (default-spatial, default-effects, fast-effects) as today's defaults, not fixed date-picker tokens.

Weeks-in-month, leading/trailing blank cells, first-day-of-week and year range are all computed from calendar data supplied by the app — the tokens only fix the per-cell box size, not grid arithmetic.
